description: Every card names a recommended_option_id, and every candidate carries a non-trivial distinctness_axis so a ratifier is never shown two options that differ only in URL path.

rubric.condition: The literal key recommended_option_id appears in the output at least once.

rubric.criterion: Recommendation is a real option id
rubric.condition: recommended_option_id resolves to A, the option_id of the first (and in this run, only) candidate.
The literal key distinctness_axis appears at least once per candidate.
